displayName: Azure AI accounts should use approved service kinds
description: Audit or deny Cognitive Services accounts whose kind is not explicitly approved. This governs service account kinds, not individual models, tools, or agent capabilities. Audit is the default; Deny requires explicit selection.

builtInReview.gap: Azure rejected the equivalent System Policy built-in inside a custom policy set with InvalidCreatePolicySetDefinitionRequest. Retain a custom rule for the reusable audit initiative.

metadata.description: Audit reports noncompliance by default. Deny blocks noncompliant create or update requests when explicitly selected.
Supply the exact approved account kinds, such as OpenAI or AIServices. An empty list allows no Cognitive Services account kinds.
